title: Writing for Film + TV Program
summary: An 8-month certificate, online or on-site, where you write a feature screenplay, an original TV pilot and a pitch package in a simulated writers’ room.

hero.imageAlt: Writing for Film + TV students working on a script

intro.heading: Unleash your potential as a screenwriter
paras: Enroll in our comprehensive screenwriting course and earn a certificate in the heart of Canada’s vibrant scriptwriting industry. In just 8 months, you will gain the skills to craft compelling full-length screenplays. Our program focuses on creating polished portfolio pieces, including an original TV pilot and feature screenplay, strategically designed to entice studios. Work in a simulated writers’ room led by experienced industry professionals and develop a captivating television series.

Additionally, our expert instructors will guide you through the art of pitching to producers and crafting pitch packages tailored to sell your script effectively. Upon completion, you will not only have honed your writing abilities but also established a diverse portfolio with saleable scripts and forged invaluable connections within the industry.

cards.title: One-on-one mentorship
cards.text: At every draft of every project you’ll receive one-on-one mentorship from our industry professional instructors. In addition, suggestions and critiques from classmates will provide ideas, highlight issues, and provide the collaborative feedback of a true writers’ room.

cards.title: Small class sizes
cards.text: Classes are kept small and intimate. Get individualized attention from award-winning, industry-professional instructors and the opportunity to connect with your classmates throughout the writing process. Build strong creative and professional relationships that last well into your career.

cards.title: Hard work, not overwork
cards.text: Classes in the Writing For Film and TV Program run four days per week. You can’t rush perfection, and that extra day allows you to commit the time needed to write quality scripts and build a polished portfolio without getting burnt out.

sections.heading: Learn from award-winning film + TV writers
paras: Instructors in the Writing For Film and TV Program are all industry professionals and award-winning screenwriters. Hundreds of combined credits allow them to pass along mastery of the latest writing trends, industry connections, and unparalleled experience. Many InFocus students have won awards, received grants, and made the selection of prestigious festivals right out of school. You could be next.

sections.heading: Write your script. Become a pro.
paras: Launch an exciting career in the screenwriting industry through multiple hands-on projects that will build a deep understanding of writing techniques, styles, and career pathways. Build a skillset that will catch the attention of top-level producers. Study from home with live, instructor-led classes delivered online or collaborate with other students in our on-campus writing room.

curriculum.heading: Learn script writing by writing scripts

modules.title: Feature screenplay
modules.text: One of the key goals of this screenwriting program is for your script to emerge as a realistic contender for production. Write your own screenplay for an original, marketable feature film, the true mark of a professional screenwriter.

modules.title: TV pilot
modules.text: An original pilot script is still considered the best way to gain a toehold in the industry. Develop and write your own 30-minute or 60-minute TV pilot script.

modules.title: Adaptation script
modules.text: Film adaptations of books, television shows, or true stories have been around since the dawn of television. But they are becoming increasingly popular in today’s market, grossing a full 53% more than original screenplays at the box office. You will be assigned a short story to adapt into a short screenplay.

modules.title: Video game level outline
modules.text: Video games are one of the biggest forms of entertainment, and are in constant need of storytellers. Develop your own concept for a AAA video game. Write the first mission with engaging construction, objectives, stimulus and rewards.

modules.title: Short film script
modules.text: The first project for most major Hollywood screenwriters was a short film script. Short films have launched the careers of filmmakers like Christopher Nolan, Taika Waititi, and Ava DuVernay. This project aims to help you learn professional formatting and find your own creative voice.

modules.title: Web series script
modules.text: Experience working in a professional writers’ room. Your instructor will bring real-world television experience and act as the showrunner for a series you develop in class. Then collaborate with your peers to write your very own episode.

modules.title: Pitch package
modules.text: To be a successful screenwriter you must have the skills to sell your scripts. Gain producing skills such as budgeting, scheduling, crewing, casting, and pitching to build a package that will entice studios to produce your script.

costs.heading: Achieve more, pay less
costs.text: InFocus Film School is one of the most financially-competitive schools in North America. We offer program costs comparable to public institutions, but with the high quality and expediency of private education. That said, financial assistance is always available, and all programs are eligible for student loans. Interest-free payment plans tailored to your specific financial needs can be arranged, and scholarships are available to qualified students. Plus, what you see is what you pay. We don’t believe in obfuscating program costs by charging by credit or adding additional fees and surcharges. The listed price is the full cost of the program and includes all tuition, material, and application fees.

accreditation.heading: Accredited screenwriting education
paras: The Writing for Film and Television Program has been approved by the Private Training Institutions Regulatory Unit (PTIRU) of the Ministry of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills.

InFocus programs do not lead to regulated career pathways, as careers in the film and media industries are not subject to occupational regulation in Canada. However, graduates often go on to work for major studios, production companies, and media organizations both locally and internationally.

details.label: Program structure
details.text: 627 hours delivered over 30 weeks of instruction. Delivery is two terms of 15 weeks each with a 1-week break. The program consists of 16 required courses.

details.label: Schedule
details.text: Full-Time, Tuesday – Friday 9:00am – 4:00pm. Students can expect to be in class at least 20 hours per week.

details.label: Attendance requirements
details.text: Minimum 500 hours for graduation eligibility. Students are expected to attend all classes, arrive on-time, and stay for the duration of the class.

details.label: Academic progress
details.text: Students are expected to make satisfactory progress in their studies and meet all assignment deadlines. Any student who fails two or more courses in a term must meet with the department head to discuss their academic performance. Passing grade equals 50%.

startDates: We offer multiple intakes throughout the year. Please contact an Admissions Advisor for upcoming start dates and availability.

requirements.intro: To be accepted into the Writing For Film and Television Program, students must:
items: Meet the terms of InFocus Film School’s [English Proficiency Policy](/policies#english-proficiency-policy)
If under the age of 19, submit proof of successful completion of grade 12 (or equivalent)
